import numpy as np

# --- Reasoning ---
# Hammer lies along Y (handle toward +Y, head toward -Y). get_hammer_pose returns the middle
# of the handle. Handle half-length >= 0.075 m, so [hy-0.05, hy+0.065] is always on the handle.
# Arm0 grasps the handle on the head side (hy-0.05), Arm1 grasps the handle on the free end
# (hy+0.065) -> ~11.5 cm separation between gripper centers along Y, and both grippers open
# along X (thin hand bodies along Y) so they don't collide during the handover.
# Keep the hammer aligned along Y the whole time (pure translation, no rotation of the object),
# transfer it at the midpoint between the arms (x ~ 0.81) at z = 0.175 (within 0.15-0.20).
# All large motions are done at a safe height, with vertical approaches via z_approach.

Q_DOWN_X_ARM0 = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm0 facing down, opening along X
Q_DOWN_X_ARM1 = np.array([0.0, 0.707, 0.707, 0.0])   # arm1 facing down, opening along X

hammer_pos, _ = get_hammer_pose()
hx, hy, hz = float(hammer_pos[0]), float(hammer_pos[1]), float(hammer_pos[2])

HANDOVER_X = 0.81          # midpoint between initial gripper positions (0.44, 1.18)
HANDOVER_Z = 0.175         # required 0.15 - 0.20
SAFE_Z = 0.32              # travel height, clear of hammer/table
ARM0_GRASP_DY = -0.05      # arm0 grasp offset along handle (toward head, still on handle)
ARM1_GRASP_DY = 0.065      # arm1 grasp offset along handle (toward free end)

# ---------------- Arm 0: pick up the hammer ----------------
open_gripper_arm0()
grasp0 = np.array([hx, hy + ARM0_GRASP_DY, hz + 0.005])
goto_pose_arm0(grasp0, Q_DOWN_X_ARM0, z_approach=0.15)
close_gripper_arm0()

# Lift straight up (translation only)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([grasp0[0], grasp0[1], SAFE_Z]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM0)

# ---------------- Arm 1: pre-position high above the handover point, out of the way ----------------
open_gripper_arm1()
arm1_grasp_xy = np.array([HANDOVER_X, grasp0[1] + (ARM1_GRASP_DY - ARM0_GRASP_DY)])
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([arm1_grasp_xy[0] + 0.12, arm1_grasp_xy[1], SAFE_Z + 0.08]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM1)

# ---------------- Arm 0: move hammer to the handover point ----------------
# Horizontal translation at safe height, then lower to handover height
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, grasp0[1], SAFE_Z]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM0)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, grasp0[1], HANDOVER_Z]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM0)

# ---------------- Arm 1: grasp the handle ----------------
# Move above the grasp point, then descend vertically onto the handle (open gripper straddles it)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([arm1_grasp_xy[0], arm1_grasp_xy[1], SAFE_Z + 0.08]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM1)
goto_pose_arm1(np.array([arm1_grasp_xy[0], arm1_grasp_xy[1], HANDOVER_Z]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM1, z_approach=0.15)
close_gripper_arm1()

# ---------------- Arm 0: release and retreat ----------------
open_gripper_arm0()
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([HANDOVER_X, grasp0[1], SAFE_Z]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM0)
goto_pose_arm0(np.array([0.5, grasp0[1], SAFE_Z]), Q_DOWN_X_ARM0)
